note: How the foam holds together and how it prints. foam_pieces / pieces: separate bodies (grounded = touches the bottom face, which prints on the bed). thin_share: share of the foam thinner than each wall thickness in feet. overhang_area_ft2: foam facing down over void (needs support when printed). plates: each floor plate with whether it joins the grounded foam body. Multiply feet by the print scale to get millimetres.
